name: What is cabinet light rail molding and do I need it?

mainEntity.name: What is cabinet light rail molding and do I need it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Light rail trim is a narrow molding installed along the underside front and side edges of wall-mounted cabinets. Its primary function is to hide under-cabinet light fixtures, transformers, and low-voltage wiring from plain view when people are seated at a nearby table or island. It also adds depth and custom detail to stock cabinetry. If you are installing under-cabinet task lighting deeper than the cabinet face frame recess, light rail molding is practically required to prevent harsh bulb glare.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light rail molding mounts underneath upper cabinets to conceal lighting fixtures and wiring, preventing glare while adding architectural detail.
